# Six Sigma CAPA Fixture

This synthetic fixture describes an improvement workflow using neutral process
terms without claiming quality-system compliance or certified methodology use.

## Problem Statement

The record captures observed defect, affected process, containment action, and
owner review before root-cause analysis starts.

## Effectiveness Check

The workflow links corrective action to metric trend, sample window, reviewer
decision, and residual risk note.

## Non-Claim Boundary

This fixture does not claim CAPA effectiveness, quality-system compliance, or
Six Sigma certification. It only exercises portable corpus artifact generation
with license-safe text.
